quotes.name: Elio Perez
quotes.quote: I’ve seen how the council’s inaction leaves us feeling forgotten, like our voices don’t matter when it comes to fixing what’s broken in our neighborhoods.

quotes.name: Depak Ying
quotes.quote: I’ve heard people talking about the civic gap, and it feels like the council’s inaction is leaving us all hanging—like they’re not really hearing what the city needs.

claim: I’ve seen how the council’s inaction leaves us feeling forgotten, like our voices don’t matter when it comes to fixing what’s broken in our neighborhoods.
